origin.description: Find the k nearest training rows for each query row.
origin.details: The query is not dropped. A query that is also a training row can be its own neighbor.
origin.example: query points (1.2, 1.2) and (8.7, 8.7) against cbind(1:10, 1:10), k=3

translation.description: get_knnx searches a query against the training points and keeps the query point when it is one of them.
translation.details: The query is not dropped. A query that is also a training row can be its own neighbor.
translation.example: query points (1.2, 1.2) and (8.7, 8.7) against cbind(1:10, 1:10), k=3
